research_topic: Improve GaLore gradient projection computational efficiency on scientific computing tasks including physics-informed neural networks for PDE solving and molecular property prediction on MolPuzzle dataset (217 molecular instances) regarding memory reduction and training speed optimization, evaluated against full-parameter training and standard LoRA approaches using 1-1.5B parameter transformer models, addressing the 2025 trend of scientific machine learning by enabling full-parameter optimization within memory constraints through low-rank gradient projection while preserving domain-specific inductive biases and physical symmetries.
